mapper.sql: d.id AS documentId, d.knowledge_base_id AS knowledgeBaseId, kb.name AS knowledgeBaseName, d.user_id AS userId, u.username AS username, d.file_id AS fileId, d.file_name AS fileName, d.file_type AS fileType, d.file_size AS fileSize, d.parse_status AS parseStatus, d.chunk_status AS chunkStatus, d.vector_status AS vectorStatus, d.error_message AS errorMessage, d.page_count AS pageCount, d.created_at AS createdAt, d.updated_at AS updatedAt
mapper.select: SELECT FROM document d LEFT JOIN knowledge_base kb ON kb.id = d.knowledge_base_id LEFT JOIN user u ON u.id = d.user_id WHERE d.deleted = 0 AND d.id = #{id}

SELECT id, user_id, knowledge_base_id, file_id, file_name, file_type, file_url, file_size, content_hash, parse_status, chunk_status, vector_status, page_count, created_at, updated_at FROM document WHERE deleted = 0 AND parse_status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE document SET parse_status = 'PENDING', error_message = '处理超时未回写，已自动重新入队', updated_at = NOW() WHERE deleted = 0 AND parse_status = 'PARSING' AND updated_at < #{deadline}
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, knowledge_base_id, file_name, vector_status FROM document WHERE deleted = 1 AND vector_purged = 0 ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE document SET vector_purged = 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 1
